MAGICA

ONE AGENT. ALL AI MODELS.

Just describe what you want.

Magica handles the rest.

Magica is the world's first autonomous AI super agent that can think, decide, and take action across every major AI model and the tools you already use—so you can get real work done without learning prompts, workflows, or complicated software.

Whether you're creating content, building businesses, automating tasks, running research, generating videos, managing projects, or connecting your favorite apps, Magica works like a capable digital teammate that handles the entire process from start to finish.

WHAT MAKES MAGICA DIFFERENT?

Most AI apps give you a chatbot.

Magica gives you an autonomous agent.

Instead of asking you which model to use, which tool to connect, or which prompt to write, Magica makes those decisions for you and executes the work automatically.

ACCESS EVERY LEADING AI MODEL

Use the world's most advanced AI models through a single agent.

• Chat models
• Image generation models
• Video generation models
• Audio generation models
• Coding models
• Research models

Magica intelligently selects the best model for the task so you don't have to.

A REAL COMPUTER INSIDE

Unlike traditional AI assistants, Magica has access to a complete digital workspace.

• Real web browsing
• File storage and organization
• Cloud compute
• Autonomous task execution

It can research, navigate websites, create assets, manage files, and complete complex workflows on your behalf.

CONNECT YOUR FAVORITE TOOLS

Magica works with the software you already use.

• Gmail
• Google Drive
• Slack
• And thousands of other tools and services

Give Magica access once and let it work across your entire digital ecosystem.

LEARN CUSTOM SKILLS

Teach Magica a process one time.

It remembers.

Create reusable workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and build personalized AI capabilities tailored to how you work.

CREATE, EDIT & MANAGE FILES

Generate documents, presentations, images, videos, spreadsheets, reports, and more.

Magica can create, store, retrieve, edit, and organize your files automatically—while remembering where everything lives.

DEVELOPER READY

Need deeper integrations?

Magica includes API and MCP support, making it easy to connect with your products, workflows, automations, and infrastructure.

AVAILABLE EVERYWHERE

Access Magica wherever you work.

• Web
• iPhone
• iPad
• Android

Your agent, conversations, files, and workflows stay synchronized across every device.

NO PROMPT ENGINEERING REQUIRED

No tutorials.

No learning curve.

No choosing between models.

No complicated setup.

Simply describe what you want in plain English.

Magica figures out the rest.

JOIN MILLIONS USING MAGICA

Download now and experience the next generation of AI.
